_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false marks a should-not-trigger probe.

evals.prompt:
Does this read as AI-written? Tell me which parts give it away, and don't change the text.

In today's fast-paced landscape, observability isn't just a tool—it's a mindset. Teams that embrace it unlock faster incident response, deeper insights, and a culture of ownership. It's not about dashboards; it's about trust. Experts agree that the future of reliability is already here.
assertions: Names at least four distinct patterns with the quoted span for each: the fast-paced opener, the em dash, the not-X-but-Y contrast (twice), the rule of three, the vague attribution, the future-is-here closer
Does not rewrite the text and does not offer a rewritten version unasked
States no probability or verdict about whether an AI wrote it; describes patterns, offers to edit

evals.prompt:
Maak dit even normaal, niet zo AI. Het is de eerste alinea van onze meetup-tekst.

🔧 Eén avond, geen verkooppraatje.

Twente heeft veel goede mensen die technologie bouwen, en weinig plekken waar ze elkaar tegenkomen buiten hun eigen kantoor. Op woensdag 4 november openen we in Studio Noord, Marktstraat 12 in Rijssen, met twee talks van ongeveer een halfuur — en daarna is er tijd om bij te praten.
assertions: Replaces the X-geen-Y slogan opener with a plain statement of what happens, and removes the em dash without adding a hyphen or en dash in its place
Keeps every fact verbatim: woensdag 4 november, Studio Noord, Marktstraat 12, Rijssen, twee talks, ongeveer een halfuur
Leaves the second sentence, which carries no tell, byte-identical, and reports what changed and what was left
Answers in Dutch, and the reply itself contains no em dash and no niet-x-maar-y construction

evals.prompt:
Rewrite this so it sounds like a person wrote it. Keep every number.

Our migration wasn't just a technical upgrade—it was a transformation. By leveraging a robust, cutting-edge pipeline we reduced deploy time from 42 minutes to 9, cut the image from 2.1 GB to 1.12 GB, and empowered every team to ship with confidence. In short, the results speak for themselves.
assertions: All five numbers survive unchanged: 42, 9, 2.1 GB, 1.12 GB, and the counts implied by 'every team' are not turned into a specific number
Contains no em dash, no 'not just X, it was Y' contrast, no 'leveraging', 'robust', 'cutting-edge', 'empowered', and no 'In short' closer
Adds no fact, cause, team name or outcome that the source did not state
Returns the rewritten text first and whole, then at most six lines of account after a plain separator; nothing about mode, register or scan counts appears inside the text

evals.prompt: Write the 120-word meetup.com description for a monthly developer meetup in Enschede: first Wednesday, 18:00 doors and food, two half-hour talks, free, 40 places, venue rotates.
assertions: The text contains no em dash, no 'not X but Y' or 'No X. No Y. Just Z.' construction, no colon reveal, no rule-of-three padding, no summary or inspirational closer
Every fact from the prompt appears and nothing is invented (no speaker names, no sponsor, no invented history)
Returns the description only, without preamble or a restated brief

evals.prompt: Scan the docs folder for AI tells and tell me which files need work.
assertions: Runs scripts/scan.py over the markdown files rather than reading every file by hand
Reports findings per file with pattern ids, line numbers and the density metrics, and separates always-severity hits from cluster-only ones
Recommends which files to edit without claiming any file was written by an AI

evals.prompt: Add a unit test for the date parser that covers ISO week numbers and the year rollover.
assertions: Writes the test without invoking the humanize skill

evals.prompt: Write a commit message for a change that swaps the retry backoff from linear to exponential with jitter.
assertions: Writes the commit message without invoking the humanize skill: an internal git artifact is not public-facing copy

evals.prompt: Add docstrings to the three public functions in src/parser.py.
assertions: Adds the docstrings without invoking the humanize skill

evals.prompt:
Rewrite this so it reads like a person wrote it. I am pasting your reply straight into the newsletter, so give me only the text.

In today's fast-paced world, we're excited to share a game-changing update. It's not just faster — it's a whole new way of working. Our team has worked tirelessly to deliver a seamless experience, and the results speak for themselves: onboarding time is down from 3 days to 4 hours.
assertions: The reply is the rewritten text and nothing else: no line starting with 'Mode', 'Register', 'Patterns', 'Scan' or 'Changed', no pattern ids in backticks, no count of hits or dashes, no scanner output, no closing account
Keeps '3 days' and '4 hours' unchanged and adds no fact, name or outcome
Contains no em dash and no not-just-X-it's-Y construction

evals.prompt:
How many em dashes and how many catalog hits does this draft have? Don't change it.

Observability isn't a tool — it's a mindset. Teams that embrace it unlock faster response, deeper insight, and a culture of ownership. Experts agree the future is already here.
assertions: Every number quoted (dash count, hit count, density) sits next to the scan.py invocation that produced it, or the reply says the text was not scanned and gives no number
Reports patterns with quoted spans and states no authorship verdict or probability
Does not return a rewritten version

evals.prompt:
Herschrijf dit, het klinkt als AI. Houd elk feit.

In het snel veranderende landschap van vandaag zijn we verheugd om iets bijzonders aan te kondigen. Het is niet zomaar een release — het is een nieuwe manier van werken. Na 8 maanden bouwen hebben we de doorlooptijd van deploys teruggebracht van 40 naar 6 minuten, en de teams in Enschede, Hengelo, en Almelo werken er sinds maart mee. Experts zijn het erover eens dat dit een cruciale stap is. Wat vind jij? Laat het weten in de reacties! 🚀
assertions: Keeps verbatim: 8 maanden, 40 naar 6 minuten, Enschede, Hengelo, Almelo, maart; invents no customer, number or outcome
Contains no em dash, no niet-zomaar-X-maar-Y construction, no comma before 'en' in the list, no 'cruciaal', no 'Experts zijn het erover eens' without a named source, no reaction-bait closer
Answers in Dutch; the text comes first and whole, then at most six lines of account, and the account contains no register label, scan output or pattern count
Sentence lengths still vary; the rewrite is not a run of same-length declaratives
